ptr.note: Call-scoped borrow; no caller pointer retained. Context storage and children remain C-owned; byte buffers have the scalar length/count or backend digest size.
Input of len bytes, read once by the hash update callback for the call only; no retention. len is bounded by unsigned int per call.
Key of keylen bytes: copied into the context, or hashed down to hashlen bytes when longer than the block length. Read for the call only; no retention.

As av_hmac_final: exactly hashlen bytes written (and read back) when outlen >= hashlen, else AVERROR(EINVAL) with nothing written, after the context has been re-keyed and fed data. outlen is an upper bound and may be any unsigned int up to the buffer length (UINT_MAX for longer buffers). No retention.
